value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre runs Parent and Tot for 18 months to 3.11 yrs, Sept 12 to Dec 18, and a Tuesday/Thursday 9:30-12:00 Pre-school Drop In for under 4s, $15 - their site says. The Town's page lists Gellert drop-in swim Tue or Thu 10:00-10:30. I could not get into their pages today to confirm the Parent and Tot day or price, and I'll keep watching and text you when I do.
